source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted AccountConfig.copy constructs a new AccountConfig and deep-copies each property because the generic copy helper alone does not preserve the base object type. captureState uses that method before passing selected configuration to the next step. For this model, use its copy method when independent editable state must retain AccountConfig behavior. This does not prove every object type supports that helper or that all consumers avoid aliasing; the copy implementation was inspected but not exercised. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: AccountConfig.copy preserves the class as well as copied properties
